simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַיָּה (H344) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַיָּה (ʼayâh) means the screamer , i.e. a hawk First listed occurrence: Deut 14 13.

definitions.full: H344. ayyah I. אַיָּה noun feminine hawk, falcon, kite (perhaps from cry; compare Arabic , a kind of hawk) Lev 11:14 ; Deut 14:13 Generic, compare לְמִינָהּ & Di; Job 28:7 (keen-sighted).
